C9, per-cell thresholds come from ±5-day pools over all 1992–2002 baseline dates (Hazen 90th percentile), smoothed with a 31-day wrapping mean. Only the smoothed values for target days of year 153–244 are used, which draw on pools for days 138–259 and hence on 12 May–20 Sep of each baseline year. These thresholds are compared with all target-day SST (2004-06-01 to 2004-08-31) for every sea cell of the 60x60 region to build the saved mask."}
